tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from consortium/JV are not acceptable.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall be individual Proprietorship firm or partnership firm or Company Registered under Companies Act 1956/2013. Bidder Shall upload Registration certificate/SSI Certificate/ Udyam Certificate (MSME)/Partnership Deed/license issued by the Commerce & Industries Department or any other Government Statutory Authority shall be uploaded. For Proprietorship firm, PAN and GST registration certificate shall be uploaded. Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro & Small Enterprises shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents as specified in Section - VII

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have Goods and Service Tax (GST) Registration and PAN Registartion shall upload the necessary supporting documents to establish compliance for having GST & PAN registration.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents as specified in Section - VII

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall be a Manufacturer and should have a minimum experience of 5 (five) years in Designing, manufacturing, testing and supply of the 220kV CT & PT (as specified in Tender document) as on the date of bid submission. The supporting documents such as Purchase Order/order completion certificates/performance certificates demonstrating experience of minimum 5 years as Manufacturer of material/equipment specified in the tender shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents as specified in Section - VII

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have manufactured and supplied at least 50 % (25% in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises) of tendered quantity i.e., at least 3 Nos (2 Nos. in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises) in State/Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities). i.01 no of 220kV class CT and 02 nos of 220kV PT or ii. 02 nos of 220kV class CT and 01 no of 220kV PT (01 no of 220kV class CT and 01 no of 220kV PT in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises). (Tenderers shall have to upload the supporting Documents such as Purchase order copies & order completion certificates, performance certificates issued by State/Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities). The performance certificate shall pertain only to the 220kV Class Current Transformer & 220kV Class Potential Transformer commissioned in State/Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities. The issuing officer of performance certificates shall not be below the rank of Executive Engineer. The performance certificate shall indicate all necessary details such as rating of the equipment, make, voltage, name of the substation where it is installed, date of commissioning etc., in order to show that the above 220kV Class Current Transformer & 220kV Class Potential Transformer were in successful operation for at least a minimum period of two years as on the date of bid submission. Tenderers shall have to upload the relevant performance certificates of the PO uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents as specified in Section - VII

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer will be disqualified if they have a record of poor performance against KPTCL/KSPDCL orders such as abandoning the contract, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion of contract, if the failure rate of the equipment/materials supplied to KPTCL/KSPDCL (either through direct orders or through EPC Contractors) placed in the preceding 5 years is more than 10% of the quantities of 220kV class CTs & PTs supplied.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents as specified in Section - VII

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should not have been DEFAULTED in supplies against Purchase Orders placed by any State/ Central Generating/ Transmission Utility/ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents as specified in Section - VII

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should not be under order of debarment/Blacklisting from participating in a Tender by any State/Central Generating/ Transmission Utility/ ESCOMs/ Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs, as on the last date of submission of bids.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents as specified in Section - VII

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years, A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Tenderer or any partner may result in rejection of Bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents as specified in Section - VII

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Financial Turnover of the Tenderer achieved in at least two financial years in the last five years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) should not be less than the the amount put to tender Rs. 24.43Lakh. However, it shall be Rs.12.22Lakh in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises. The Tenderer shall upload the Audited Financial statements i.e. Balance sheets Profit & Loss statements, Annual Turnover Certificates duly certified by a Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant documents as specified in Section - VII

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: KSPDCL at its discretion, may conduct type tests and/or additional type tests as per technical specifications of the subject tender conducted as per the relevant IS/IEC standards at its cost, on a randomly selected 220kV Class Current Transformer & 220kV Class Potential Transformer by KSPDCL officials, at any point of time during the contract at CPRI Laboratory. In case KSPDCL opts for conducting type tests and/or additional type tests at CPRI on the randomly selected 220kV Class Current Transformer & 220kV Class Potential Transformer, the same will be conducted at KSPDCLs cost. Applicable testing charges of CPRI shall be paid by the supplier upfront and the same is reimbursable by the KSPDCL as per actual, on submission of bills along with proof of payment, on successful passing of tests. However, the transportation and insurance charges shall be borne by the supplier himself. In case of failure of 220kV Class Current Transformer/& 220kV Class Potential Transformer during testing, the 220kV Class Current Transformer/& 220kV Class Potential Transformer will not be accepted by KSPDCL and KSPDCL will not reimburse the testing charges of CPRI. Further, the order placed on the Firm will be cancelled and the performance Bank Guarantee will be forfeited. Tenderer shall upload an undertaking agreeing to the criteria & to bear transportation & insurance charges.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall upload Test reports not older than Ten years as on the date of bid submission for having conducted successful type tests and additional type tests as specified in tender technical specifications, on 220kV Class Current Transformer & 220kV Class Potential Transformer as per the relevant IS/IEC standards.
